title: Concorde high back 24HR executive synchro-tilter (2424)
body_html:
The 24-hour executive chair trusted in the Oval Office — built to run three shifts a day without flinching.

The Global Concorde 2424 is a heavy-duty executive synchro-tilter engineered for round-the-clock, multi-shift workplaces — dispatch desks, control rooms, security posts, and any seat that never cools down. It supports users up to 350 lbs, carries GREENGUARD Gold, ANSI/BIFMA and ISO 14001 certification, and puts pneumatic seat-height and tilt-lock on push-button arm controls so any user can dial in their fit in seconds.

Key features

  • Certified for 24-hour / multi-shift applications
  • Supports heavy, big & tall users up to 350 lbs
  • Push-button arm controls — pneumatic seat height + tilt lock
  • Synchro-tilt with tilt-tension adjustment and 5-position tilt-lock
  • Seat height adjustment 18"–22"
  • Sliding seat depth adjustment 16"–18" (18"–20" deeper seat on request)
  • 7-position concealed ratchet back-height adjustment with lumbar support
  • Waterfall seat front edge and contoured cushions
  • Carpet or hard-floor casters; black base; leather optional

Who it's for

Facilities and operations managers outfitting 24/7 environments — hospital nursing stations, 911 dispatch, campus security, and manufacturing control rooms — plus executive offices that demand all-day durability and big-and-tall capacity.

Brant Business Interiors carries the Global Concorde 2424 and delivers across Ontario, with installation available. Call 1-800-835-9565 to confirm finishes, seat-depth options, and OECM pricing for your facility.
